c.v: The module receives data two clock cycles after the end bit of a data-read command, even if the command path detects a response error or a CRC error.
If no response is received from the card and a response timeout occurs, the BIU does not receive a signal about the completion of the data transfer.

If the command sent by the CIU is an illegal operation for the card, it would prevent the card from starting a read-data transfer, and the BIU will not receive a signal about the completion of the data transfer.
If no data is received by the data timeout, the data path signals a data timeout to the BIU, which marks an end to the data transfer.
